item.title: Son says Ocala nursing facility ignored mother’s broken hip, hygiene before untimely death

item.title: I think Walmart could get rid of skip-scanning by replacing self-checkout lanes with cashiers
item.description: "To the Editor: When is Walmart going to learn that ever since they decided to put in the Self-Service check-out lanes that a lot of people are going to try and beat the system? I would think that some (?) people may have gotten away with a few items that weren't scanned at the self-checkout registers, but the majority of people who have decided to not scan many items have not gotten away with it and are sitting in jail because of it.
